signal: Teamworks raised $235M Series F at a $1.3B valuation (June 2025) to push AI across sports, building on acquisitions including Smartabase, Zelus Analytics, and Opteamal.

email.body1:
Casey, saw Teamworks raise its $235M Series F at a $1.3B valuation to accelerate AI across sports.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Teamworks off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Casey, quick follow-up for Teamworks.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump faster than headcount can. Most directors cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Teamworks needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Casey, last bit of proof for Teamworks.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Teamworks' reply rate likely compares to other high-growth startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Casey, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a raise, and the post-Series F stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Teamworks either way.
